scope.focus: German from absolute zero through A1–C2 performance, post-C2 precision, academic/professional language, literature, linguistics, corpus-informed usage, and open research.
includes: Pronunciation, phonology, listening, and orthography from lesson one
Grammar and syntax as an integrated meaning system
Vocabulary, collocation, phraseology, and word formation
Speaking, interaction, pragmatics, and sociolinguistic register
Reading and writing from survival texts to academic/literary prose
Culture, literature, historical change, and mediation
Post-C2 corpus linguistics, German linguistics, literary analysis, and research
